items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Joe Wilder and I joined the band at the same time in San Francisco, Hamp's band. And they isolated us, and we were roommates on the road

ctx.x: Well, don't the guys tell him something?

Joe Wilder did. He said, dog dablits -- (inaudible) that's the way he cussed -- dog gablits, I won't be there. I'll be there for whatever time you're going to start up (inaudible) be there,and he was the first one there warming up.
